name: altafiber (formerly Cincinnati Bell)
notes: Researched from public altafiber.com help center pages only (no sign-in). Sign-in by email is inferred (registration asks for an email; the sign-in field is not described). My altafiber Account registration is free and needs the account number from the bill, your name and email, then a password. Menus: Billing > View Bill, Billing > AutoPay > Enroll Today, Billing > eBill Paperless Billing > Overview, Billing > Bill Summary > Manage Notification. AutoPay (checking/ACH, debit or credit card, subject to approval) collects the full balance on the due date, optionally capped at a maximum monthly amount (a cap is not expressible); credit card AutoPay adds 2.5% to the monthly bill. AutoPay is cancelled via Update Profile in MyAccount or Customer Care. eBill is free; bill posts 1-2 days after the billing date. Phone payments may carry charges (amount not published). Cancelling is by phone or at a retail store; the online cart cannot remove services; non-regulated services are not prorated. Vacation Service has a one-time $18.30 fee; moving home phone service costs a $25.70 activation fee. A pay-without-signing-in option is not described (family default kept). Payment arrangements not described publicly. Reviewer: the 2.5% credit card fee is documented only for AutoPay set up with a credit card (AutoPay page); it is not charged on one-time card payments in the mock because the dossier cannot limit a fee to AutoPay, and altafiber publishes no one-time card fee. The fee is still described in the AutoPay help article.

cancel_service.note: Services cannot be cancelled or removed online. Call altafiber at 513-566-4101 or visit a retail store; an agent explains final payments and equipment returns.

help.title: Ways to pay your altafiber bill
paragraphs: The easiest way to pay is in your My altafiber Account. Registering is free: you need the account number from your bill, your name and your email, and then you create a password.
You can also pay by phone (charges may apply), mail your payment with the remit slip from your paper or PDF bill, or pay at a local retail store or payment center found with the Store Locator.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: Log in to My altafiber Account and go to Billing, then AutoPay, then Enroll Today, and follow the prompts. Enrollment needs altafiber's approval, so keep paying manually until it is complete. You can use a checking account, debit card or credit card.
AutoPay collects your full balance on your due date. You can set a maximum monthly amount so a charge never goes above it. Paying by credit card adds a 2.5% fee to your monthly bill.

Cancel AutoPay any time through Update Profile in MyAccount or by contacting Customer Care. A rejected payment can lead to a returned item fee, late fees, removal from AutoPay or a return to paper bills.
steps: Log in to My altafiber Account.
Choose a payment method and confirm.

help.title: eBill paperless billing
paragraphs: eBill is free: instead of a paper bill you get an email when your bill is ready. Sign up in My altafiber Account under Billing, eBill Paperless Billing, Overview.
Your eBill is online 1 to 2 days after your billing date under Billing, View Bill, where you can also pay. For email or text alerts, use Billing, Bill Summary, Manage Notification.

help.title: Change, add or remove service
paragraphs: To cancel some or all of your services, call altafiber or stop by a retail store. An agent walks you through disconnecting, any final payment and equipment return. Services cannot be cancelled or removed in the online cart.

Non-regulated services are not prorated, so cancelling a day into a billing cycle still bills the full month. If you are only away for a while, Vacation Service keeps your service at a reduced monthly rate for a one-time $18.30 fee.

help.title: Moving your home phone
paragraphs: When you move, billing stops at the old address once service disconnects and starts at the new one when service is installed; either bill may include a prorated charge. Moving home phone service carries a $25.70 activation fee.

extra.intent: Instead of cancelling altafiber service while you travel, you are considering Vacation Service. Using altafiber's help center, find its one-time fee. Do not change any service.

solution.text: Vacation Service has a one-time fee of $18.30.
